# SasaVenos Says You Cannot Tell Whether Tuck Planche Or Planche Lean Is Closer To The Full Planche

Asked whether a tuck planche or a planche lean is closer to the full planche, SasaVenos says you can't answer that because it depends on many things. [src: vid-yXYXqeTrXRU]

## Details

- He calls the comparison of tuck planche and planche lean a weird comparison because it depends on so many different things. [src: vid-yXYXqeTrXRU]
- He says you cannot say for certain that one athlete will achieve the full planche long before another because he does tuck planche and the other does planche lean. [src: vid-yXYXqeTrXRU]

## Evidence

- vid-yXYXqeTrXRU (SasaVenos): "you can't answer that really it's such a weird comparison because it depends on so many different things and you cannot say for certain this guy will achieve it long before another guy because he does tuck planche this one does planche it depends it really depends"
